content: Trouble no one about their sacred faith; respect others in their view, and demand that they respect yours.
author: Native American Proverbs
explanation: The Great Spirit speaks to every tribe and culture in the dialect of their own heart. To harass others, wage religious crusades, or force ideological conformity is an insult to the vast diversity of creation. Live with clean dignity, grant freedom, and stand firm in your truth.
practicalInsight: Offer unconditional respect to someone whose religious or cultural beliefs differ from your own today.
reflectionPrompt: Are you respecting the spiritual boundaries of others, while also standing firm in your own sacred values?
